calculation_handling.description: Amending By-law 1075-2026, item 28, deletes regulation 10.5.60.20(10) from Zoning By-law 569-2013.
calculation_handling.gaps: An amendment instruction that deletes a regulation with no replacement; keyed as DISAPPLY (displaces 10.5.60.20(10)) — a PROCEDURAL reading is also possible. "28" is the item number of the amending by-law, recorded as count_or_ordinal_not_a_limit in case it is not treated as a regulation number. The deleted regulation's content is not in this brief, so no zone, building type or use can be evidenced.

10.5.60.20(10)@1075-2026.explanation: By-law 1075-2026 removes regulation 10.5.60.20(10) from the zoning by-law, so it no longer applies.
